subtitle: Cross-check of 13/Oct/2026, ninth day of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): Polymarket at the confirmed reading of 13/Oct, 16:14 BRT, the four national polls of 12 and 13/Oct (PoderData/Aya, BTG/Nexus, Futura/100% Cidades and Gerp) and the six earlier ones conducted after the vote, the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally and the press flow of 12 and 13/Oct.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 13.50% (cumulative volume USD 22.49M) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 13/Oct, 16:14 BRT, up 1.00pp against the confirmed reading of 12/Oct at 15:00 BRT, published in the previous update. COUNT: 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). POLL: 46% to 48% in PoderData/Aya of 13/Oct; ahead only in Vox Brasil of 09/Oct, 44.2% to 42.7%.
fortes: He leads Vox Brasil of 09/Oct by 44.2% to 42.7%, within the margin of 2.15 points, and has 50.86% of the valid votes.
In PoderData/Aya, the distance to Flávio Bolsonaro narrows from 5 points in the 05 to 07/Oct wave to 2 in the 10 to 12/Oct wave, within the margin of 1.8 points either way.
🏆 Counting the closed contracts, his contract is still the one with the highest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 22.49M.
fracos: He stands at 13.50% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 13/Oct, 16:14 BRT, and Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over him is 72.95pp.

He trails in nine of the ten national polls conducted after the vote: 46% to 48% in PoderData/Aya, 45% to 48% in BTG/Nexus and 46.6% to 50% in Futura/100% Cidades of 13/Oct, 44% to 53% in Gerp of 12/Oct and 44% to 50% in DataTrends of 11/Oct.
He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 1.87 points behind Flávio Bolsonaro, with 45.16% of the valid votes against 47.03%.
In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 03/Oct government approval went from 46% to 44%, with 49% disapproval.
candidates.analise: Lula stands at 13.50% in the winner contract (cumulative volume USD 22.49M), confirmed reading of 13/Oct, 16:14 BRT, and rises 1.00pp against the confirmed reading of 12/Oct at 15:00 BRT, published in the previous update. 🗳️ He had 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). 📊 In PoderData/Aya of 13/Oct he has 46% against 48%, three points closer than in the 05 to 07/Oct wave, and his government is disapproved by 50% and approved by 44%. Before the four national polls of 12 and 13/Oct, DataTrends of 11/Oct gave Flávio Bolsonaro 50% to 44%, Ipespe of 10/Oct 49% to 44% and AtlasIntel of 09/Oct 51.1% to 45.7%, and Vox Brasil of 09/Oct gave Lula 44.2% to 42.7%; on 08/Oct, Datafolha gave Flávio Bolsonaro 49% to 45% and PoderData/Aya 49% to 44%. On 13/Oct, Lula announced Prospera MEI, six measures for individual microentrepreneurs (MEIs) with debt forgiveness estimated at R$ 12.6 billion and a Pix of up to R$ 5 thousand; part of it depends on Congress and is scheduled for implementation from 2027 (Poder360 and Estadão). ⚖️ On 13/Oct, the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) president, Kassio Nunes Marques, again took down the "Exército do Lula" channel, overturning the decision of the inspector general (Corregedor-Geral) Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, and made its return conditional on registering the channel with the Electoral Justice within 48h; Lula's campaign registered the channel the same day, and Kassio authorized its return, which only takes effect 48 hours after the registration (Estadão, G1 and Metrópoles). On 12/Oct, the TSE's advisory office for combating disinformation said it had not found on the channel, from 02 to 11/Oct, the false posts cited by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, but flagged risk from polarizing language and deleted messages (Estadão and Valor). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the schedule: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 86.45% (cumulative volume USD 19.80M) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 13/Oct, 16:14 BRT, down 0.60pp against the confirmed reading of 12/Oct at 15:00 BRT, published in the previous update. COUNT: 47.03% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). POLL: 48% to 46% in PoderData/Aya of 13/Oct; ahead in nine of the ten post-vote national polls.
fortes: He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) ahead, with 47.03% of the valid votes against Lula's 45.16%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally.
He stands at 86.45% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 13/Oct, 16:14 BRT.

He leads nine of the ten national polls conducted after the vote: 48% to 46% in PoderData/Aya, 48% to 45% in BTG/Nexus and 50% to 46.6% in Futura/100% Cidades of 13/Oct, 53% to 44% in Gerp of 12/Oct and 50% to 44% in DataTrends of 11/Oct.
He has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema and Michel Temer.
Among Ronaldo Caiado's voters, he has 56% against 15% in Ipespe, 54.9% against 26.9% in AtlasIntel and 57% against 19% in PoderData/Aya.
fracos: He trails in Vox Brasil of 09/Oct, with 42.7% against 44.2%, and in PoderData/Aya his lead narrows from 5 points to 2 between the 05 to 07/Oct and 10 to 12/Oct waves.

🏦 According to O Globo, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) is investigating, in the inquiry into Daniel Vorcaro and Master's relationship with BRB, the bank's R$ 3.1 million financing to Flávio Bolsonaro for the purchase of a R$ 6 million mansion in Brasília; he says the transaction was legal, and the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution.

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro's arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 86.45% in the winner contract (cumulative volume USD 19.80M), confirmed reading of 13/Oct, 16:14 BRT, and falls 0.60pp against the confirmed reading of 12/Oct at 15:00 BRT, published in the previous update. 🗳️ He had 47.03% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). 📊 Four national polls came out between the night of 12/Oct and 13/Oct, all with total votes: PoderData/Aya (3,000 interviews from 10 to 12/Oct) gives Flávio Bolsonaro 48% to 46%, 51% to 49% in valid votes; BTG/Nexus (2,002, from 10 to 12/Oct), 48% to 45%, 52% to 48% in valid votes; Futura/100% Cidades (2,000, from 07 to 10/Oct), 50% to 46.6%, 51.8% to 48.2% in valid votes; and Gerp (2,400, on 08, 09 and 12/Oct, released on the night of 12/Oct), 53% to 44%, 55% to 45% in valid votes (Jovem Pan, CNN Brasil, Poder360, Exame and Conexão Política). Before them, DataTrends of 11/Oct gave Flávio Bolsonaro 50% to 44%, Ipespe of 10/Oct 49% to 44% and AtlasIntel of 09/Oct 51.1% to 45.7%, and Vox Brasil of 09/Oct gave Lula 44.2% to 42.7%; on 08/Oct, Datafolha gave Flávio Bolsonaro 49% to 45% and PoderData/Aya 49% to 44%. 🤝 Flávio Bolsonaro has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema and Michel Temer, and the MDB president said the party announces on 13/Oct majority support for him (G1); 17 MDB state branches are with Flávio Bolsonaro and 10, from the North and Northeast, declared support for Lula (Estadão, Valor and CartaCapital). PSDB stayed neutral. Lula has the support of UP, PSTU and PCB (CNN Brasil and G1), and Renan Santos still backs no one (CNN Brasil and Estadão). After visiting his father, Jair Bolsonaro, on 13/Oct, Flávio Bolsonaro said he will vote in the Senate in favour of ending the 6x1 work schedule (six days on, one off) and asked for compensation for companies (UOL and Gazeta do Povo); the vote is scheduled for 14/Oct (G1). ⚖️ On 13/Oct, the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) president, Kassio Nunes Marques, again took down the "Exército do Lula" channel, overturning the decision of the inspector general (Corregedor-Geral) Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, and made its return conditional on registering the channel with the Electoral Justice within 48h; Lula's campaign registered the channel the same day, and Kassio authorized its return, which only takes effect 48 hours after the registration (Estadão, G1 and Metrópoles). On 12/Oct, the TSE's advisory office for combating disinformation said it had not found on the channel, from 02 to 11/Oct, the false posts cited by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, but flagged risk from polarizing language and deleted messages (Estadão and Valor). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the endorsements: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): third place, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 08/Oct (G1, Estadão and CNN Brasil).
fortes: He finished third, with 2.89% of the valid votes, ahead of Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado.
The [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno)'s third-place book was resolved in his favour.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid more for Renan Santos, 47.50%, and for Ronaldo Caiado, 30.00%, than for him, 23.70%.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in third, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. The first round's third-place book, which on the eve paid 23.70% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, was resolved in his favour. 🤝 On 08/Oct he declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round (G1, Estadão and CNN Brasil).

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): fourth place, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): he backs neither of the two.
fortes: He finished fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes, ahead of Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18%.
His contract in the winner book closed with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, and third place went to Augusto Cury.
candidates.analise: Renan Santos finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book, behind Lula's. On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, and it was resolved in favour of Augusto Cury. 🤝 On the night of 04/Oct he said he backs neither of the two in the second round and freed Missão's activists to choose (Gazeta do Povo and Agência Brasil).

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema, with 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad did not run for President. PRICE: the three winner contracts were closed and resolved at zero.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the leading pack, with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally (100% of polling sections) and the closing of the winner contracts after the first round.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 2.18% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.82M cumulative.
caiado.fortes: He declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct, with governor Daniel Vilela (O Globo and VEJA).
caiado.fracos: He finished fifth, behind Renan Santos, and the PSD decided on neutrality in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
haddad.fortes: The top of his series in the winner contract was 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He was not measured by any national poll in a presidential scenario or in a second-round pairing.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 0.27% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
zema.fortes: ⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of his voters would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), the largest transfer among the names measured (O Globo).
zema.fracos: He had 0.27% of the valid votes. He declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on 05/Oct, and Novo declared support for him on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).

candidates.analise: 🗳️ Ronaldo Caiado finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fifth, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema had 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad ran for governor of São Paulo, not for President. The three contracts in the winner book were closed by Polymarket and resolved at zero. 🤝 Romeu Zema declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on the night of 05/Oct (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo), and Novo, his party, declared support on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital). Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), even with the PSD neutral in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), and Romeu Zema declared his vote for him on 05/Oct, followed by Novo on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).
⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of Romeu Zema's voters and 42% of Ronaldo Caiado's would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (O Globo).
fracos: The two are out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and the winner contracts of all three names were resolved at zero.
Fernando Haddad did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno).

cruzamento: Ninth day of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), with four new national polls and ten conducted after the vote. 💹 In the confirmed reading of 13/Oct, 16:14 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro falls 0.60pp and Lula rises 1.00pp against the confirmed reading of 12/Oct at 15:00 BRT, published in the previous update, and the gap goes from 74.55pp to 72.95pp. 📊 Four national polls came out between the night of 12/Oct and 13/Oct, all with total votes: PoderData/Aya (3,000 interviews from 10 to 12/Oct) gives Flávio Bolsonaro 48% to 46%, 51% to 49% in valid votes; BTG/Nexus (2,002, from 10 to 12/Oct), 48% to 45%, 52% to 48% in valid votes; Futura/100% Cidades (2,000, from 07 to 10/Oct), 50% to 46.6%, 51.8% to 48.2% in valid votes; and Gerp (2,400, on 08, 09 and 12/Oct, released on the night of 12/Oct), 53% to 44%, 55% to 45% in valid votes (Jovem Pan, CNN Brasil, Poder360, Exame and Conexão Política). Before them, DataTrends of 11/Oct gave Flávio Bolsonaro 50% to 44%, Ipespe of 10/Oct 49% to 44% and AtlasIntel of 09/Oct 51.1% to 45.7%, and Vox Brasil of 09/Oct gave Lula 44.2% to 42.7%; on 08/Oct, Datafolha gave Flávio Bolsonaro 49% to 45% and PoderData/Aya 49% to 44%. Of the ten national polls conducted after the vote, nine put Flávio Bolsonaro ahead, by 2 to 9 points in total votes, and Vox Brasil puts Lula ahead by 1.5 points. In PoderData/Aya, the distance narrows from 5 points in the 05 to 07/Oct wave to 2 in the 10 to 12/Oct wave. On rejection, 46% would not vote for Lula under any circumstances and 44% for Flávio Bolsonaro in PoderData/Aya, and 51% and 47% in BTG/Nexus. The voters of Augusto Cury, who declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 08/Oct, go to him by 56% to 27% in PoderData/Aya and by 50% to 29% in Ipespe, and to Lula by 50.4% to 38.9% in AtlasIntel. Among Ronaldo Caiado's voters, all three point to Flávio Bolsonaro. 🤝 Flávio Bolsonaro has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema and Michel Temer, and the MDB president said the party announces on 13/Oct majority support for him (G1); 17 MDB state branches are with Flávio Bolsonaro and 10, from the North and Northeast, declared support for Lula (Estadão, Valor and CartaCapital). PSDB stayed neutral. Lula has the support of UP, PSTU and PCB (CNN Brasil and G1), and Renan Santos still backs no one (CNN Brasil and Estadão). ⚖️ On 13/Oct, the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) president, Kassio Nunes Marques, again took down the "Exército do Lula" channel, overturning the decision of the inspector general (Corregedor-Geral) Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, and made its return conditional on registering the channel with the Electoral Justice within 48h; Lula's campaign registered the channel the same day, and Kassio authorized its return, which only takes effect 48 hours after the registration (Estadão, G1 and Metrópoles). On 12/Oct, the TSE's advisory office for combating disinformation said it had not found on the channel, from 02 to 11/Oct, the false posts cited by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, but flagged risk from polarizing language and deleted messages (Estadão and Valor). 🎙️ Record cancelled the 11/Oct debate, citing scheduling conflicts, and the second round has three debates scheduled: 15/Oct (SBT, RedeTV! and CNN Brasil), 18/Oct (Band) and 23/Oct (Globo), plus interviews with both candidates on Globo (Gazeta do Povo and Poder360). 📊 The next national polls registered with the TSE come out on 14/Oct ([Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest)), 15/Oct (Datafolha, Palver and Indexa), 16/Oct (PoderData, MDA, 100 Cidades and Datavero), 17/Oct (Veritá and Ipespe) and 18/Oct (Vox Brasil and Phoenix); AtlasIntel of 15/Oct and Vox Brasil of 16/Oct were removed from the TSE registry. ⛔ The panel does not attribute price moves to the polls, the endorsements or the day's acts: it measures the sides with each one's timestamps.
